headline: Production of electric buses with a Turkish company may be launched in Samarkand from 2027
summary: A preliminary agreement has been reached to start electric bus production in Samarkand with Turkish company Anadolu from 2027. About $250 million in projects with Turkish firms are planned in the region next year.
why: Electric bus manufacturing involves industrial investment and technology transfer, and foreign-backed projects shape Uzbekistan's industrial and export development. Anadolu is a Turkish industrial group.
original_headline: Samarqandda 2027-yildan Turkiya kompaniyasi bilan elektrobuslar ishlab chiqarish yo‘lga qo‘yilishi mumkin
